propositions: Four workflow files (test.yml, optionality.yml, prompt-eval.yml, verify-identity.yml) must add 'tickets' to their branches-ignore lists to prevent push-triggered CI runs on the tickets branch.
A new enumerating test must validate that no workflow file in .github/workflows/ matches a push to the tickets branch, and fail if a future workflow is added with a bare push trigger.

Documentation must warn adopters that auto-pushed tickets-branch writes trigger CI unless workflows exclude it, with canonical guidance in docs/concurrency.md and cross-links in user-guide.md and config.md.
Schedule cadences for all modified workflows must remain byte-identical and explicitly verified in tests to preserve replacement behavior.
Push CI for ordinary topic branches must be preserved, confirmed by asserting wip-some-topic still matches all four edited workflows and feature/** and main are still excluded.
gerrit-verify.yaml must remain workflow_dispatch-only, enforced by existing test_gerrit_verify_stays_a_dispatch_only_patchset_gate continuing to pass.
